title: Bounded reset and field loading
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, valid input-head position $p$, stream prefix $\mathrm{pre}$, field word $w$, stream tail, and old target word, there is a time $t\le 2|\mathrm{old}|+3|w|+6$ at which the unrestricted loader, started in its reset control with stream contents $\mathrm{pre}\,\langle w,\mathrm{tail}\rangle$, stream head at $|\mathrm{pre}|$, and target contents $\mathrm{old}$ with head at zero, reaches the completed reading control. At that time the target contains exactly $w$ with its head at zero, the stream head is at $|\mathrm{pre}|+2|w|+2$, and the input position, stream contents, and empty physical output are as specified by the corresponding reader configuration.
hypotheses_covered: At time $t$, equality with the specified completed reader configuration
replaced: For every input word, input position, stream prefix $u$, field word $w$, stream tail, and old target, there is a time $t \le 2\,(\text{old length}) + 3|w| + 6$ after which the unrestricted loader, started at the reset phase with stream cursor $|u|$, holds exactly $w$ on its target with head zero and stream cursor just past the consumed field; the native input and physical output are unchanged, and the stream moves only during reading.
